# Parse the old songs list and match with fetched songs
import re

content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by "
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artists_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append((title, set(artists)))
    else:
        # maybe just title? but we'll ignore
        pass

print("Old songs parsed:", old_songs)

# Build a set of matching song IDs from songs_details
matching_song_ids = set()
for song_id, song in songs_details.items():
    song_title = song['title']
    song_artists = set(a['name'] for a in song['artists'])
    for old_title, old_artists in old_songs:
        if song_title == old_title and song_artists == old_artists:
            matching_song_ids.add(song_id)
            break

print("Matching song IDs:", matching_song_ids)
